notes: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) on Vertex AI. Build a final prompt for each icon as: style_prefix + subject + style_suffix. The two style sets share the same 16 subjects so the only difference is look-and-feel. Filenames are keyed by the category slug used in the Thulobazaar database (the single source of truth).

flat.style_suffix: , single centered object on a fully transparent background. Bold, friendly, modern flat vector illustration: rounded geometric shapes, clean crisp edges, flat even lighting, NO gradients, NO drop shadows, NO 3D, NO photorealism. Restrict all colors to this exact palette: rose-red #F43F5E as the dominant accent, deep slate #1F2937, warm amber #FBBF24, emerald green #10B981, sky blue #3B82F6, and soft off-white #F8FAFC. The object is perfectly centered and fills about 80% of the square frame with generous even padding. Keep stroke weight, proportions, corner radius and overall visual weight consistent so it belongs to a matching set of 16 marketplace category icons. Fully transparent (alpha) background, no tile, no plate, no scene. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words, logos or watermark. Square 1:1, ultra-crisp, high-resolution, premium app-icon quality.

glossy.style_prefix: Premium soft-3D glossy app icon of
glossy.style_suffix: , single centered object floating on a fully transparent background. Smooth rounded three-dimensional forms with a polished glossy finish, gentle lighting from the top-left, subtle smooth gradients, soft white specular highlights, and a soft contact shadow directly beneath the object. High-end iOS-style icon look, but with NO square background tile or plate, only the object and its soft shadow on transparency. Use this cohesive palette: rose-red #F43F5E as the dominant accent, deep slate #1F2937, warm amber #FBBF24, emerald green #10B981, sky blue #3B82F6, with soft white speculars. Keep material, lighting direction, depth, proportions and bevel consistent so it belongs to a matching set of 16 marketplace category icons. The object is centered and fills about 75% of the square frame with even padding. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words, logos or watermark. Square 1:1, ultra-crisp, high-resolution, transparent (alpha) background.

negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, words, captions, watermark, signature, logo, background scene, frame, border, photorealistic, photograph, clutter, extra objects
